fidelity_notes: The immutable linux/amd64 image pins the complete environment; worker receipts record exact installed versions of Python, torch, transformers, numpy, safetensors, tokenizers and pydantic.
Image metadata was verified from Docker Hub; this image has not been executed on NVIDIA hardware as part of milestone 2.
The original experiment did not release a runtime lock. This is a declared reproduction environment, not a claim of identical upstream hardware or sampled outputs.
Image CUDA version is 13.0.2. The GPU host must provide a compatible NVIDIA driver and NVIDIA Container Toolkit.
